AL.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. No exceptions for rape or incest. Medical emergency exception only.

AR.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Limited medical emergency exception.

ID.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Medical emergency exception only.

IN.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Exceptions for rape, incest, and serious health risk to the patient.

KY.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Medical emergency exception only.

LA.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Narrow medical emergency exception.

MS.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Medical emergency exception only.

MO.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Medical emergency exception only.

ND.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Exceptions for rape, incest (up to 6 weeks), and medical emergency.

OK.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Medical emergency exception only.

SD.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Medical emergency exception only.

TN.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Medical emergency exception only.

TX.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Civil and criminal liability for those who aid or perform abortions. Narrow medical emergency exception.

WI.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect under an 1849 law. Status subject to ongoing legal challenges — verify current enforceability.

WV.summary: Near-total abortion ban in effect. Narrow exceptions for rape, incest, and medical emergency.

FL.summary: Prohibited after approximately 6 weeks (cardiac activity). Exceptions for rape, incest, human trafficking, and medical emergencies.

GA.summary: Prohibited after approximately 6 weeks (cardiac activity). Exceptions for rape, incest, fetal anomaly, and medical emergencies.

IA.summary: Prohibited after approximately 6 weeks (cardiac activity). Exceptions for medical emergencies, rape, incest, and fetal abnormalities.

KS.summary: State constitution protects abortion access. Prohibited after 22 weeks with limited exceptions. 24-hour mandatory waiting period.

NC.summary: Prohibited after 12 weeks with exceptions for rape, incest, fetal anomaly, and medical emergencies. 72-hour mandatory waiting period.

NE.summary: Prohibited after 12 weeks with exceptions for medical emergencies, rape, and incest.

OH.summary: State constitutional amendment (Issue 1, 2023) protects abortion rights. Statutory restrictions through 22 weeks remain subject to litigation — verify current law.

SC.summary: Prohibited after approximately 6 weeks (cardiac activity). Exceptions for rape, incest, fetal anomaly, and medical emergencies.

UT.summary: Prohibited after 18 weeks. 72-hour mandatory waiting period after state-directed counseling. Exceptions for medical emergencies and fetal anomalies.

WY.summary: Abortion ban subject to ongoing litigation — status may have changed. Verify current enforceability before prescribing.

AK.summary: State constitution protects abortion access through viability and beyond for health reasons. No mandatory waiting period.

AZ.summary: Abortion legal through viability. Proposition 139 (2024) enshrined abortion rights in the state constitution.

CA.summary: State constitution protects abortion access. No gestational limit for health of the patient. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.

CO.summary: No gestational limit or waiting period. Proposition 89 (2024) enshrined abortion access in the state constitution.

CT.summary: Legal through viability; after viability when necessary for health of patient. No mandatory waiting period.

DC.summary: No gestational limit or mandatory waiting period. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.

DE.summary: Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period.

HI.summary: Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.

IL.summary: Legal through viability; after viability when necessary for health of patient. No mandatory waiting period.

MA.summary: Legal through 24 weeks; after 24 weeks when necessary for health of patient. No mandatory waiting period.

MD.summary: Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.

ME.summary: Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period.

MI.summary: Proposal 3 (2022) enshrined abortion rights in the state constitution. Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period.

MN.summary: State constitution protects abortion access. No gestational limit. No mandatory waiting period.

MT.summary: State constitution protects abortion access through viability. No mandatory waiting period.

NH.summary: Legal through 24 weeks with exceptions after. No mandatory waiting period.

NJ.summary: Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.

NM.summary: No gestational limit or mandatory waiting period. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.

NV.summary: Legal through 24 weeks. No mandatory waiting period.

NY.summary: Legal through 24 weeks; after 24 weeks when necessary for health of patient. No mandatory waiting period. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.

OR.summary: No gestational limit or mandatory waiting period. Measure 111 (2022) enshrined abortion access in the state constitution.

PA.summary: Legal through 24 weeks. 24-hour mandatory waiting period. In-person visit required.

PR.summary: Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period.

RI.summary: Legal through viability; after viability when necessary for health of patient. No mandatory waiting period.

VA.summary: Legal through the second trimester. Third trimester permitted when necessary for health of patient. No mandatory waiting period.

VT.summary: Article 22 of the state constitution (2022) guarantees personal reproductive autonomy. No gestational limit or waiting period.

WA.summary: Legal through viability. No mandatory waiting period. Telehealth medication abortion permitted.
